```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: pr-branch

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          path: main-branch

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies (PR)
        working-directory: pr-branch
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install dependencies (Main)
        working-directory: main-branch
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build (PR)
        working-directory: pr-branch
        run: npm run build

      - name: Build (Main)
        working-directory: main-branch
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run Benchmarks
        id: benchmark
        run: |
          # Configuration
          WARMUP_RUNS=2
          MEASURED_RUNS=5
          TARGET_DIR="benchmark-target"
          
          # Create a dummy target directory to pack
          mkdir -p $TARGET_DIR
          echo "dummy content" > $TARGET_DIR/dummy.txt
          
          # Function to run benchmark for a specific branch directory
          run_benchmark() {
            local branch_dir=$1
            local times=()
            
            # Warmup runs
            for i in $(seq 1 $WARMUP_RUNS); do
              cd $branch_dir
              node dist/index.js $TARGET_DIR > /dev/null 2>&1
            done
            
            # Measured runs
            for i in $(seq 1 $MEASURED_RUNS); do
              cd $branch_dir
              # Use time command to get real time in seconds with high precision
              local start_time=$(date +%s%N)
              node dist/index.js $TARGET_DIR > /dev/null 2>&1
              local end_time=$(date +%s%N)
              local elapsed_ns=$((end_time - start_time))
              local elapsed_s=$(echo "scale=4; $elapsed_ns / 1000000000" | bc)
              times+=($elapsed_s)
            done
            
            # Calculate median
            IFS=$'\n' sorted=($(sort -g <<<"${times[*]}")); unset IFS
            local mid=$((MEASURED_RUNS / 2))
            local median=${sorted[$mid]}
            echo $median
          }
          
          # Run benchmarks
          PR_TIME=$(run_benchmark "pr-branch")
          MAIN_TIME=$(run_benchmark "main-branch")
          
          # Calculate difference
          DIFF=$(echo "$PR_TIME - $MAIN_TIME" | bc)
          if (( $(echo "$MAIN_TIME > 0" | bc -l) )); then
            PERCENT=$(echo "scale=1; ($DIFF / $MAIN_TIME) * 100" | bc)
          else
            PERCENT="0.0"
          fi
          
          # Determine sign for display
          if (( $(echo "$DIFF > 0" | bc -l) )); then
            SIGN="+"
          else
            SIGN=""
          fi
          
          # Format output for comment
          echo "PR_TIME=$PR_TIME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "MAIN_TIME=$MAIN_TIME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "DIFF=$DIFF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "PERCENT=$PERCENT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "SIGN=$SIGN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post Benchmark Comment
        uses: mshick/add-pr-comment@v2
        with:
          message-id: perf-benchmark
          message: |
            ## Performance Benchmark
            
            | | Time |
            |---|---:|
            | PR branch | ${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.PR_TIME }}s |
            | main branch | ${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.MAIN_TIME }}s |
            | **Diff** | **${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.SIGN }}${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.DIFF }}s (${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.SIGN }}${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.PERCENT }}%)** |
            
            *Benchmarked by packing the repository itself.*
```
